# vngcloud_vdb_kafka_package (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vngcloud_vdb_kafka_package" "kafka_s_general_2x4" {
  name = "db-kafka.s-general-2x4-n10"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported by the resource:

- **name** (String, Required): Name of the kafka package


## Attributes Reference

In addition to all arguments above, the following attributes are exported:
- **id** (String, Computed):
    - The ID of the kafka package (flavor ID).

- **cpu** (Int, Computed):
    - The number of CPU cores allocated to the resource. This field is computed and available after the data source is queried.

- **ram** (Int, Computed):
    - The amount of RAM (in GB) allocated to the resource. This field is computed and available after the data source is queried.
